response.sql: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals), status_avgs AS (SELECT rfistat AS status, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), kept AS (SELECT status, avg_modindex FROM status_avgs CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE avg_modindex > overall_avg) SELECT status, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - overall_avg AS above_baseline, avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM kept) AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept CROSS JOIN baseline
